Our game.
New
cities.

Our game is one of the most physical and fluid team sports in the world. Most of the world hasn't seen it yet.

We're taking it to them.

The Aussie Rules Takeover is a one-day knockout exhibition — curated squads, prize money, and every moment of the game at its most exciting. We bring the broadcast, the spectacle, and the competition. We're looking for the right people to help bring it to life on the ground.

It's the spirit
of the game
we love.

Modified
for this
moment.

A modified rule set designed for a short, intense one-day comp — true to the game, built to put every moment of skill and physicality front and centre. Smaller squads, more ground covered, more of what makes this game worth watching.

The Mark
Proper marking pressure — reinstate the contest
Play On
Less whistle. More footy.
Accuracy or It Costs You
Modified exciting scoring — rewards the bold
Shorter Quarters
Shorter matches. More footy in one day.
Overtime
First to three goals wins — pure pressure footy

More than
a match.

This is a one-day showcase event — built to the standard of the best events in any city. Footy at the centre, everything else around it.

Live footy. Food. Music. Atmosphere.

From first bounce to the final siren — it runs as a full event. The kind of day people come back from and talk about. The kind of event you want your name on.

Like the games
of old —
strong and bold.

One day.
Knockout
format.

Shorter matches. More footy in one day.

Pool Matches
  • All squads play — shorter rounds, every result matters
  • Winners advance, losers fight to stay alive
Finals Footy Energy
  • Knockout rounds — one loss and you're watching
  • Overtime deciders if it's level at the siren
  • The Decider — prize money on the line, champions crowned

Broadcast.
Streamed.
Commentated.

Every match covered. Live broadcast, streaming, and open commentary — built into the event from day one. The game goes out, wherever the audience is.

The stream is open. Take the feed, add your call, make it yours.
